- Initial release of Professional Video Local AI.
- Edit and export professional-grade videos locally, with no cloud uploads required.
- Simple workflow: upload your raw footage, describe the edit, and download your polished video in 1–3 minutes.
- Supports 4K output, silence cutting, color grading, titles, and more—just type your instructions.
- Secure session handling using NEMO_TOKEN, with free credits available for new users.
- Clear status updates, built-in error handling, and detailed guidance for all editing actions.
